proof_body:
by
  intro A _ hd B C _ _ i f hi
  classical
  letI : DivisibleBy A ℤ :=
    { div := fun x n => if h : n = 0 then 0 else (hd x n h).choose
      div_zero := fun x => by simp
      div_cancel := fun {n} x hn => by simpa [hn] using (hd x n hn).choose_spec }
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := (Module.Baer.of_divisible A).extension_property_addMonoidHom i hi f
  exact ⟨F, fun b => DFunLike.congr_fun hF b⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [AddCommGroup A], (∀ (x : A) (n : ℤ), n ≠ 0 → ∃ y, n • y = x) → ∀ (B C : Type*) [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C] (i : B →+ C) (f : B →+ A), Function.Injective i → ∃ F : C →+ A, ∀ b, F (i b) = f b
